description: This PHP file defines a migration class for version 5.6.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to update database schemas, manage language strings, set up OAuth providers, and insert API permissions, serving as part of the system's update process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles the database schema updates, language string management, and OAuth provider setup for version 5.6.0 of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps such as updating language strings, setting foreign keys, creating new tables, and cleaning up providers.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '5.6.0' associated with this migration.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database if their current version is null.

methods.name: modifyAuthProviderTables
methods.description: Alters existing provider tables to update column types and attributes.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: removeOpenIdProviders
methods.description: Deletes or updates OpenID providers based on their type.

methods.name: changeGoogleProviderURL
methods.description: Updates the provider URL for Google OAuth providers.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes language string translations based on unit ID and group ID.
